svg.title: Every request is a round trip
svg.desc: Top-down cartoon map shaped like a loop. Dirt roads leave Your app along the top, pass through two tall wooden checkpoints (Gate and Router) that span both the top and bottom roads, then past three wooden huts above the road (Cache, Vault, Customs), each up a short side road. Then the road splits into four (OCR, Messages, Responses, Chat), tunnels through a hill to the model providers, and the way back loops down and runs left along the bottom past two huts between the roads (Post office, Ledger), back through the Router and Gate to Your app. Horse wagons carry tags naming their API. Stations are numbered 1 to 7 in visit order.
svg.text: Every request is a round trip
Out along the top through the checkpoints and stations, to the provider, and back around the bottom.
